name: Molicel INR-21700-P42A
description: 21700 lithium-ion cell, 4200 mAh, 45 A continuous discharge.

specs.label: Capacity
specs.value: 4200 mAh typical (15.5 Wh), 4000 mAh minimum (14.7 Wh)

specs.label: Voltage
specs.value: 3.6 V nominal, 4.2 V charge, 2.5 V discharge cutoff

specs.label: Impedance
specs.value: 10 mΩ AC (1 kHz), 16 mΩ DC (10 A / 1 s)

envelope.axes: x = cell height 70.15 mm (max, positive terminal at +X), y and z = diameter 21.55 mm (max); lying on its side, so the cylinder touches the floor at z = 0

features.label: Positive terminal
features.source: Not given in the data sheet. Flat-top cell: a small raised cap inside an insulating ring on the positive end. Keep it plain and within the stated height.

notes: Molicel publishes no CAD and no dimension drawing: the data sheet gives only the maximum diameter and height. Model the cell as a plain cylinder at those maximums (it is the envelope a holder or pocket must clear), axis along X, positive end toward +X, wrapped can. The positive end is a flat-top terminal cap inside an insulating ring; the negative end is the flat can bottom. Cap diameter, cap height, ring size, the crimp groove and the wrap thickness are not dimensioned: keep the positive end simple (at most a shallow, conservative raised cap inside the stated height) and list them under Not dimensioned. No tabs or leads.
